scope: Bounded sequential WebKit and Firefox, 390/1280px, three repetitions: actual app recordVisibleControls focus inventory on dashboard and invoice detail immediately followed by document close; separate real user invoice-link click/back/reload with critical UI readiness. Native console location, requestfailed and lifecycle events kept with UTC/monotonic page IDs and closing state. Browser binding can miss lifecycle events when document execution is terminated; raw callbacks are observed only, no fetch overrides or application edits. Original matrix two diagnostics remain separate and unverified if not reproduced. Synthetic isolated fixture only; external origin requests blocked.
rawEventDiagnostics: All timestamped original request/response/requestfailed/native/console/pageerror events remain unchanged in rawSource; consoleIssues, pageErrors and requestFailures are retained fully in this published proof
assessment: All36 critical UI/navigation checks completed; Firefox diagnostic reproduced twice during native reload with no pageerror and subsequent critical UI ready. Temporal association does not identify the failing callsite or prove harmlessness. Original matrix WebKit fallback was not reproduced and both original causes remain qualified as unverified.

publication.scope: Own candidate14 source/build guards and actual observations retained. Synthetic credential/capability patterns replaced only in published copy; raw proof, console/network diagnostics and logs remain unfiltered locally. No measurements inherited from older candidates.
